title: Pickleball Smash
style: Jazz swing big band with 1970s swagger, bouncy syncopated groove, walking bass, brass hits, and flirtatious Spanish guitar licks; verse rides close-mic female vocals over sparse drums and upright bass, pre-chorus opens with trumpet jabs and handclaps, chorus hits with shouted brass stabs and stacked harmonies, bridge drops to brushed kit and call-and-response ad libs; add whistle pickups, trombone slides, and a quick horn fall into the hook; bright, punchy, and retro-glossy, big band, pop, swing, jazz
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Michelle mishy mish mash
I came in with a smash
Tennis pro in my stride
Then pickleball took my pride

TRUCK GOT ME GOOD
right out in the lot
XRAY smash
that ache still got me hot

[Pre-Chorus]
I can’t run, but I can roll
I can still own that kitchen goal
Watch my feet, watch my hand
I’m back to serve, I’m back to stand

[Chorus]
Pickle ball smash, smash
Pickle ball smash
Michelle mishy mish mash
Pickle ball smash

Bee bop bee bop
pop that third shot
Pickle ball smash
I’m all that I got

[Verse 2]
Used to chase the court line
Now I pick my spots fine
Soft hands, sharp aim
Baby, that’s a new game

I read the bounce, I read the spin
Let the little dinks sink in
From center line to the net
Best comeback you ever get

[Pre-Chorus]
I can’t run, but I can roll
I can still own that kitchen goal
Watch my feet, watch my hand
I’m back to serve, I’m back to stand

[Chorus]
Pickle ball smash, smash
Pickle ball smash
Michelle mishy mish mash
Pickle ball smash

Bee bop bee bop
pop that third shot
Pickle ball smash
I’m all that I got

[Bridge]
Brass say ay, I say olé
Move that ball the tricky way
Soft drop, then boom
Make that whole crowd room

[Chorus]
Pickle ball smash, smash
Pickle ball smash
Michelle mishy mish mash
Pickle ball smash

Bee bop bee bop
pop that third shot
Pickle ball smash
I’m all that I got
